manifest.population: 24 fresh complete reference-carrying directives balanced twelve exact-text preservation and twelve complete-meaning preservation cells

estimand.aggregation: equal qualifier-stratum mean per encoding; headline is the maximum encoding mean
estimand.comparator: the proposal's full careful-English preservation mapping, never a shortened paraphrase
estimand.interpretation: token price only; this does not establish comprehension, fidelity, reference validity, or adoption
estimand.population: the 24 complete fresh reference-carrying directives frozen in this manifest

manifest.selection: All actions and immutable versioned references were frozen before any fresh-input token count. Text-fixed comparators name decoded-Unicode identity constraints; meaning-fixed comparators name force, scope, attribution, conditions, exceptions, time, references, and opaque literals. No abbreviated control is used.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus English tokens per complete pair for each pinned encoding under tiktoken 0.13.0; average within each qualifier stratum, weight the two strata equally, and report the maximum encoding mean as the least-favourable token_delta with the member span.
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.evidentiary_limit: This deterministic carrier prices only the fixed verbose full mappings. It does not test the shorter practical competitors and does not establish comprehension, decoded-sequence fidelity, semantic fidelity, reference validity, or adoption.
